items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 27 April 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the west of Ireland as a trough affects the North Sea and eastern parts of Britain.


##Wind##

North or northwest 2 to 4, soon increasing 3 to 5, veering east or northeast overnight into tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Risk of areas of mist and isolated fog patches to start, otherwise fair.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in any mist and very poor in any fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 3 to 5, falling variable 2 to 4 at times.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
